description: A clock generator running from 30 to 200 beats per minute, with whole, half, quarter, eighth and sixteenth outputs and six more carrying the Linn Drum swing timings.

params.text: Sets the tempo, from 30 to 200 beats per minute; the value is cut to a whole number before the clock uses it.
Sets how long each output stays at 5V, from 10 to 60 per cent of a sixteenth note.
Starts and stops the clock; each press flips it, and the lamp is lit while it runs.
Chooses whether the six swing outputs pulse on eighth notes or on sixteenth notes.

inputs.text: Returns the count to the first sixteenth of the bar each time the voltage rises through 0.5V, and starts the clock running whether or not it was stopped.
Adds to the BPM knob at 17 beats per minute per volt, with the total clamped between 30 and 200.
Adds to the WIDTH knob at 5 per cent of a sixteenth note per volt, with the total clamped between 10 and 60 per cent.
Flips the clock between running and stopped each time the voltage rises through 0.5V.

outputs.text: 5V for the set width on the first sixteenth of each bar, once every four beats.
5V for the set width on the first and the ninth sixteenth of each bar, twice every four beats.
5V for the set width on every fourth sixteenth, once per beat.
5V for the set width on every second sixteenth, twice per beat.
5V for the set width on every sixteenth of the bar.
A pulse train at the rate the SWING switch sets, evenly spaced, which is the 50 per cent entry of the Linn Drum swing table.
A pulse train at the rate the SWING switch sets, with every second pulse pushed late by 8 per cent of a sixteenth note, the 54 per cent Linn Drum swing timing.
A pulse train at the rate the SWING switch sets, with every second pulse pushed late by 16 per cent of a sixteenth note, the 58 per cent Linn Drum swing timing.
A pulse train at the rate the SWING switch sets, with every second pulse pushed late by 24 per cent of a sixteenth note, the 62 per cent Linn Drum swing timing.
A pulse train at the rate the SWING switch sets, with every second pulse pushed late by 32 per cent of a sixteenth note, the 66 per cent Linn Drum swing timing.
A pulse train at the rate the SWING switch sets, with every second pulse pushed late by 42 per cent of a sixteenth note, the 71 per cent Linn Drum swing timing.

notes: the clock comes up running and needs nothing patched into it; the green panel shows the tempo and the pulse width as numbers.
every output here is either 0V or 5V, and all eleven are driven from one 16-step count of a four-beat bar.
